response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM project_rates WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT pr.arcref AS project_ref, pr.fundflux AS funding_source, pr.rate AS rate, pr.rate - b.bench AS gap FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.rate IS NOT NULL AND pr.rate > b.bench ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;
